port.comment: Loopback HTTP port for the Local Agent (1–65535). Match the port in Extension Settings. Restart the Agent after changing it.

visualMapTimestampFont.comment: Font filename from agent/tools/fonts used for timestamp overlays. Use a filename, not a host path.

mediaCaptureFrameMaxFrames.comment: Maximum requested frames in one media_capture_frame batch; default 20, range 1–100.

mediaClipMaxSegments.comment: Maximum requested intervals in one media_clip task; default 20, range 1–100. Omitting segments processes the whole source as one interval.

cameraRecordAudioMaxMinutes.comment: Maximum duration of one camera_record_audio recording, in minutes; default 10, range 1–1440.

cameraRecordVideoMaxMinutes.comment: Maximum duration of one camera_record_video recording, in minutes; default 1, range 1–1440.

libraryStoreMaxFiles.comment: Maximum Workspace files in one library_store_start batch; default 5, range 1–100.

libraryStoreMaxFileSizeMiB.comment: Maximum individual Library-upload file size in MiB (1048576 bytes). Larger files are skipped and reported; default 100, range 1–512.

mediaToChatMaxFiles.comment: Maximum Workspace files in one media_to_chat batch; default 5, range 1–100. Independent of the Library limit.

mediaToChatMaxFileSizeMiB.comment: Maximum individual current-chat upload size in MiB. Larger files are skipped and reported; default 100, range 1–512.

completedTaskHistoryLimit.comment: Maximum retained completed/failed/cancelled records per task manager; default 2000, range 1–100000. Oldest terminal records are removed from memory and Extension task storage. Active/queued work and output files are never deleted. Timer records are also lost on Agent restart.

newToolsEnabledByDefault.comment: Developer default for newly discovered tools without a saved individual preference. true enables them; false leaves them disabled. Existing per-tool choices are preserved. The Extension reads this from the Agent; if the Agent is unavailable it uses the last known value, initially true. Refresh the MCP schema after adding tools.
